t: You're at the site of St Andrew Hubbard, a parish church in the Billingsgate ward of the City. It was destroyed in the Great Fire of London in 1666 and was never rebuilt, so there's no church to see now. Lord Richard Moore is recorded as dying here, with dates given as 1532 to 1546, which would make him very young. The record says little else about him, so I'll just note that his name is tied to this lost church.
